facts.heading: GP visit results
facts.content: Daniel had blood tests which were all normal. The GP said it was stress and exhaustion.
facts.evidence: She had blood tests. They were all normal. She said it's stress and exhaustion.

facts.heading: GP advised no talking
facts.content: The GP said Daniel had no time to talk to someone.
facts.evidence: they said I hadn't got the time.

facts.heading: Girlfriend Claire's observation
facts.content: Claire said she was watching Daniel disappear. Claire is very patient and makes tea for Daniel.
facts.evidence: She said she was watching me disappear. She's very patient. She makes me tea and doesn't push me to talk.

facts.heading: Claire's change in behavior
facts.content: Claire stopped asking Daniel to go away for the weekend because Daniel always said no.
facts.evidence: She stopped asking if I want to go away for the weekend because I always said no.

facts.heading: Emails cause hesitation
facts.content: Daniel hesitates to say yes to plans because of emails. Daniel has to respond to about 200 emails if he is away.
facts.evidence: The emails. If I'm away I'll come back to 200 of them.

facts.heading: Rest has a price
facts.content: Daniel feels that rest has a price. He cannot remember the last time he was brought off.
facts.evidence: So even rest has a price? Can't remember the last time I was brought probably off.

facts.heading: Stopped running recently
facts.content: Daniel stopped running about two months ago. He ran three sets every Saturday morning for six years.
facts.evidence: I stopped about two months ago. I ran. I got me three sets every Saturday morning. I've done it for six years.

facts.heading: Legs feel like loud
facts.content: Daniel's legs feel like they are loud now. He has not gone back to running.
facts.evidence: My legs feel like, like, loud. And I just never went back.

facts.heading: Lost part of self
facts.content: Daniel thinks he has lost a part of himself. He recalls being unreachable for two one time in the week when he ran.
facts.evidence: I think I've lost a part of myself. It was two one time in the week, nobody could reach me.

facts.heading: Boss sends late emails
facts.content: Daniel's boss sends emails at 11 at night and expects an answer before breakfast.
facts.evidence: he sends emails at 11 at night and expects an answer before breakfast.

facts.heading: Fear of job loss
facts.content: Daniel is afraid his boss might let him go due to a restructuring in the spring.
facts.evidence: There's a restructuring in the spring and I'm afraid they'll let me go.

facts.heading: Physical symptoms of stress
facts.content: Daniel feels a lot of tiredness and irritability apart from the tiredness.
facts.evidence: A lot mostly. And irritable.

facts.heading: Panic attack experience
facts.content: Daniel slept with a colleague last week and sat in the toilet for 10 minutes. His hand was shaking while Harry was going.
facts.evidence: I slept with a colleague last week or in nothing and went and sat in the toilet for 10 minutes. Harry was going and my hand was shaking.

facts.heading: Frightening experience on train
facts.content: Daniel has experienced frightening events a couple of times. One instance was on a train to Manchester.
facts.evidence: Couple of times. Once on a train to Manchester, just to get off and stand on a platform.

facts.heading: Avoids telling others
facts.content: Daniel had not told anyone about the frightening experience. This included Claire.
facts.evidence: I hadn't told anyone about it, not even Claire.

facts.heading: Coffee consumption habit
facts.content: Daniel drinks about six cups of coffee a day.
facts.evidence: I'm on about six cups a day

facts.heading: Drinks wine in evenings
facts.content: Daniel has started having wine in the evenings to switch his head off.
facts.evidence: I've started having wine in the evenings to switch my head off.

facts.heading: Drinks wine quantity
facts.content: Daniel drinks two to three glasses of wine in the evenings.
facts.evidence: Two glasses, sometimes three.

facts.heading: Wine effect duration
facts.content: The wine helps for about an hour. Daniel wakes up three times anyway.
facts.evidence: Easy. It works for an hour. I wake up three anyway.

facts.heading: Wine feeling unhelpful
facts.content: Daniel feels the wine is not helping. He feels like he is listing everything wrong with him.
facts.evidence: It doesn't feel useful. It feels like I'm listing everything that's wrong with me.

facts.heading: Wants to sleep first
facts.content: Daniel thinks he would like to put the rest of the issues down first.
facts.evidence: I think probably you wouldn't even notice.

facts.heading: Sleep desire
facts.content: Daniel thinks he would probably go put the rest down if he could sleep.
facts.evidence: If I could sleep I could probably go put the rest.

facts.heading: Caring for family history
facts.content: Daniel thinks his family history shaped how he handled things.
facts.evidence: don't think about your family growing up, shape how you handled this.

facts.heading: Grandfather's behavior
facts.content: Daniel notes his grandfather never complained about anything.
facts.evidence: He never complained about anything, not once.

facts.heading: Daniel's self-perception
facts.content: Daniel stated he is not weak but very tired.
facts.evidence: I'm not weak, just very tired.

facts.heading: Wants to think about self
facts.content: Daniel is unsure if he believes he is not weak yet.
facts.evidence: Maybe, I don't know if I believe it yet.

facts.heading: Proposed evening routine
facts.content: They discussed fixing time in the evening when Daniel switches off his phone.
facts.evidence: Fix time in the evening when you switch off your phone, Even for 20 minutes.

facts.heading: Proposed time for routine
facts.content: Daniel suggested trying the routine around half past nine.
facts.evidence: Yeah, half past nine perhaps.

facts.heading: Agreed to next week session
facts.content: Daniel agreed to the next session time.
facts.evidence: Same time next week? Yeah, I'll be here.
